results.title: AI scores in the top percentile of creative thinking
results.content: Creativity involves generating something new – a product or solution that didn’t previously exist. # **AI scores in the top percentile of creative thinking**. Of all the forms of human intellect that one might expect artificial intelligence to emulate, few people would likely place creativity at the top of their list. When people are at their most creative, they’re responding to a need, goal or problem by generating something new – a product or solution that didn’t previously exist. When prompted with tasks requiring creative thinking, the novelty and usefulness of GPT-4’s output reminded me of the creative types of ideas submitted by students and colleagues I had worked with as a teacher and entrepreneur. With researchers in creativity and entrepreneurship Christian Byrge and Christian Gilde, I decided to put AI’s creative abilities to the test by having it take the Torrance Tests of Creative Thinking, or TTCT.
